cohort: The study included 511 live births whose NICU admission records were collected from a tertiary care center in South Kerala.
finding: The prevalence of NICU admissions among newborns was 42.86%, with jaundice (54.4%) being the major cause.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to have a statistically significant association with low birth weight and respiratory distress.
followup_time: up to NICU discharge (majority 4-6 days), within 28 days of birth
birth_weight: N/A (low birth weight mentioned as an associated factor, not a specific inclusion criterion)
gest_age: N/A (preterm neonates <35 weeks mentioned as an associated factor, not a specific inclusion criterion)
